lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Reward: Small Antenna ×2

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ☆I received the footage★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It's absolutely marvelous!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It's unlike anything else on television.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Most of all,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: you've played to the camera wonderfully, Commander!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Very dashing when you issue commands. ★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: You can really feel the bond

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: between you and your Nikkes☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Now, this is what I call true realism!☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Life isn't all doom and gloom, you know?
Did you just say I was... dashing?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I can't thank you enough, Commander.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Do you know of ★Tetra Line's CEO, Mustang☆?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I have the utmost respect for him.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Anyway, he has a quote I'm quite fond of.
And what's that?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: All girls should shine★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: All Nikkes should be stars☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Sure, all those fuddy-duddy documentaries can give you the facts,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: but they don't make you FEEL anything for the Nikkes!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: If anything, all those stodgy filming techniques alienate

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: the Nikkies, causing the audience to fail to

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: identify with the Nikkes' struggles☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: That's why I want to shake things up. Keep it all nice and simple.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Good old-fashioned love stories

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: with an outlandish backdrop of the surface★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: It will definitely stir up the audience's emotions

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: and make them root for these goddesses fighting for us up on the surface!

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I want to make Nikkes appear more approachable,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: and someone that the audiences can relate to.
Why are you vouching so hard for Nikkes?

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: As I told you,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: every Nikke can, and should, be a star☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: The only one who understood the genius of my writing,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: the only person worthy of being called ★refined★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: is Tetra Line's CEO,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: ★Mustang☆!
I see.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Hehehe★

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Anyway, I think I've made my point.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I must leave you now, and return to that cruel and dreadful

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: world of writing☆

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: You've done the Ark a great service today.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: With this magnificent footage,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: I will usher in a new age of creativity,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: as well as a cinematic renaissance!☆★☆★☆★☆
Good luck with that.

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: Thank you,

lines.speaker: lovelydream
lines.text: and good day to you☆★☆★☆★☆★☆
